name: Northflank Sandbox Free
free_limit: Sandbox free plan: 2 application services, 2 jobs and 1 database, with up to $20/month of Northflank Cloud resources; always-on services without sleeping.
watch_out: For testing and hobby projects, not production workloads. Beyond sandbox resources, usage is billed; BYOC provider costs are separate. Official pricing currently says no card needed but an older billing help page says a payment method is required for all plans, so card requirement needs confirmation.
